message.content: {"findings":[{"title":"Read-modify-write race in bulkIncrement","category":"concurrency","severity":"high","confidence":"high","evidence":[{"path":"src/counter.ts","startLine":33,"endLine":44,"symbol":"bulkIncrement","quote":"Promise.all(tasks)"}],"reasoning":"All N tasks call increment() concurrently; each reads then writes the file without locking, so the final count loses updates.","reproduction":"Call bulkIncrement(5) starting from count=0 and observe the final count is typically 1 or 2 rather than 5.","recommendation":"Serialize the read-modify-write or use an atomic counter.","whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis":"No test exercises concurrent invocations of bulkIncrement.","suggestedRegressionTest":"Run bulkIncrement(N) from a known starting count and assert final count equals start+N.","minimumFixScope":"Add a mutex (or a sequential for-await loop) in bulkIncrement around the existing increment() chain."}],"inspected":{"files":["src/counter.ts"],"symbols":["bulkIncrement","increment"],"notes":["file lock semantics inspected; no advisory or OS-level locking present"]}}
